title: FB-018 break desktop API package import cycle
summary: Fix FR-002 by preventing the desktop API package from eagerly importing LocalApiServer while core API command modules import path dialog helpers.
reason: Worker finding FR-002 showed importing core API command modules can recurse through mediapipeline.desktop.api.__init__, server, and command_handlers before the original command module is initialized.
behavior_before: A fresh process importing mediapipeline.core.api.commands_process first failed with ImportError from a partially initialized command module.
behavior_after: The desktop API package keeps the LocalApiServer compatibility export but resolves it lazily, so path-dialog submodule imports no longer import server during core command-module initialization.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_api_path_dialogs -q passed, 6 tests; direct fresh-process import check passed; tests.python.desktop.test_rename_workbench.RenameBackendBrowseModeTests tests.python.desktop.test_rename_workbench.RenameBackendPathDialogScriptTests -q passed, 3 tests; tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_core_contracts -q passed, 13 tests; tests.python.desktop.test_api_contract_payload -q passed, 18 tests. Attempted broad tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_local_api.LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_queue_and_rename_preview_contracts -q still fails on an unrelated rename_apply_payload ok assertion.

validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed only for unrelated uncovered files: docs/implementation/dynamic-hdr-preservation/PLAN.md, docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
rollback_plan: Restore the eager LocalApiServer package import and remove the fresh-process import regression, then rerun targeted Local API tests.
notes: Packet created before code edits. Reproduced pre-fix failure with a fresh-process import of mediapipeline.core.api.commands_process before mediapipeline.desktop.api.LocalApiServer.
